title: 第十三章 王艺拦人
content_zh:
陈木虽然尴尬，不过他也不是故意的，但他现在的肚子确实饿了，已经好几天没有吃过饭，倒不是陈木没有钱吃饭，而是陈木最近一段时间一直在研究提升实力以及赚钱，如果不是唐大生带来了这么多食物来，陈木还真不一定会想到吃饭这件事。

    虽然尴尬，不过陈木还是端走了一碗饭，虽然陈木很想吃菜，不过他也知道自己看光了孙依诗，如果还十分不要脸的把菜也端走吃掉，恐怕明天自己就要卷铺盖走人了。

    苏林依看到陈木直接端走了一碗饭，气得指着陈木不知道说什么好了，她还是第一次见到脸皮这么厚的家伙，自己还没让他拿饭呢，竟然自顾自的直接拿起饭就往外走了。

    不过这还不是最重要了，重要的是，陈木这个色狼竟然将孙依诗给看光了，不行！明天一定要将陈木赶走，不管父亲怎么说！苏林依已经下定决心了，她感觉她刚刚一时心软将陈木留在别墅就是个错误的决定。

    不过苏林依的想法，陈木自然不会知道，他早就拿着白米饭回到小木屋，三下五除二给解决掉了，吃晚饭后，陈木感觉精力恢复了一些，盘坐开始了一天的修炼，对于吃的东西，陈木并不是很在意，只要能补充体力就行，在苍月大陆的时候，陈木还是低阶修真者的那会，就连虫子他也吃过很多。

    ……

    孙依诗这时候穿好衣服从楼上下来了，脸色微红，对着苏林依道：“陈木走了啊？”

    “恩，他不走，难道你还想让他看会啊。”苏林依没好气的跟孙依诗说了一句

    “哼！自然不会，看过本小姐的身体，以后我会让陈木加倍还回来的。”孙依诗嘟着小嘴，哼了一声，不过很快又跟苏林依玩了起来。

    唐大生送来的饭菜很多，两女自然吃不下，看着剩下的食物，孙依诗道：“依依姐，要不将剩饭剩菜给陈木吃吧，他应该还没吃呢。”

    苏林依瞪了孙依诗一眼，心道，你都被陈木给看光了，还帮着他说话干嘛，直接拒绝道：“不是有阿黄吗，给阿黄吃就行了。”

    说着也不管孙依诗惊讶的目光，直接将剩饭剩菜连盆带碗端到了阿黄旁边，阿黄看到后，立刻开心的对着苏林依摇着尾巴，口水直流。
content_en:
Although Chen Mu was embarrassed, he didn't mean it, but he was really hungry now. He hadn't eaten for several days. It wasn't that Chen Mu didn't have money to eat, but that Chen Mu had been studying improving his strength and making money recently. If Tang Dasheng hadn't brought so much food, Chen Mu wouldn't have thought of eating.

Although he was embarrassed, Chen Mu still took away a bowl of rice. Although Chen Mu wanted to eat the food, he also knew that he had seen all of Sun Yishi. If he took away the food and ate it shamelessly, he would probably pack up and leave tomorrow.

When Su Linyi saw Chen Mu taking away a bowl of rice, she was so angry that she pointed at Chen Mu and didn't know what to say. This was the first time she had seen such a thick-skinned guy. She didn't even let him take the meal, but she picked up the meal and walked out.

But that's not the most important thing. What's important is that Chen Mu, a pervert, actually showed Sun Yishi to himself. No!Chen Mu must be driven away tomorrow, no matter what his father says!Su Linyi had already made up her mind. She felt that she had made a wrong decision by leaving Chen Mu in the villa for a moment.

However, Chen Mu naturally didn't know what Su Linyi was thinking. He had already returned to the cabin with white rice and solved it with three strokes, five strokes and two divisions. After dinner, Chen Mu felt that his energy had recovered a little, and he sat cross-legged and started practicing for the day. Chen Mu didn't care much about what he ate, as long as it could replenish his physical strength. In Cangyue Continent, when Chen Mu was a low-level cultivator, he even ate a lot of bugs.

…

Sun Yishi got dressed and came downstairs at this time. Her face was slightly red and she said to Su Linyi, "Is Chen Mu gone?"

"Well, if he doesn't leave, do you still want him to watch for a while?" Su Linyi said to Sun Yishi angrily.

"Hmph! Of course not. After seeing my body, I will ask Chen Mu to pay back double the amount in the future." Sun Yishi pouted and snorted, but soon started playing with Su Linyi again.

Tang Dasheng sent a lot of food, and the two girls naturally couldn't eat it. Looking at the remaining food, Sun Yishi said: "Sister Yiyi, why don't you give the leftovers to Chen Mu? He probably hasn't eaten yet."

Su Linyi glared at Sun Yishi and thought to herself, Chen Mu has already seen you, why are you still helping him speak? She refused directly: "Isn't there Ah Huang? Just give it to Ah Huang."

As he spoke, he didn't care about Sun Yishi's surprised look, and directly brought the leftovers and bowls to Ah Huang. When Ah Huang saw it, he immediately wagged his tail happily at Su Linyi and drooled.
